summary: BUDGY v3.8.0 E2E Famille Cloud — HARD BLOCKER: the SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql migration is NOT applied on prod Supabase (https://supabase.budgy.ch). Direct REST probes confirm: table public.group_invites → PGRST205 (missing), column expense_groups.member_user_ids → 42703 (missing), RPC join_group_by_code → PGRST202 (missing), RPC leave_group → PGRST202 (missing). Consequently scenarios 2-9 are impossible to execute (User B cannot join, cross-account RLS cannot be tested, leave_group throws, etc.). Additional web-preview UX bug: React Native Share.share() throws an uncaught 'Share is not supported in this browser' error overlay when generating the invite code (family.tsx:280). Local-only scenarios that could still be tested (S1 partial creation, S10 UI validation, S11 persistence) PASS. Verdict: FIX_NEEDED — user must run /app/docs/SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql in Supabase SQL editor BEFORE Build 70.

1_create_group_and_code.notes: Group AUDIT-GROUP-A created locally (id g_<ts>), 8-char code 67PX4P76 generated and displayed in hero ('Code: 67PX4P76'). BUT: (a) publishInviteCode() failed with 'Could not find the table public.group_invites in the schema cache' (PGRST205) — code is NOT usable by other accounts. (b) Share.share() threw 'Share is not supported in this browser' → uncaught Error overlay shown in web preview (dev only, but should be try/catch).

2_userB_join.reason: Cannot join: RPC join_group_by_code(p_code) missing (PGRST202) AND group_invites table missing (PGRST205). Even if RPC existed, publishInviteCode never wrote the code to the DB.

4_rls_userA_sees_B_expense.reason: expense_groups.member_user_ids column missing (42703) → RLS cross-user policy from SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql not deployed. User A cannot see User B expenses.

8_owner_cannot_leave.reason: RPC leave_group missing — server-side owner check unreachable. Client would receive an error but not 'owner_cannot_leave' → wrong alert copy shown to user.

9_owner_delete_cascade.reason: No shared members to observe cascade — SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql infra missing

10_invalid_code_ui.notes: UI length gate works: Rejoindre button is disabled when code length ≠ 8 (verified with 'ABC'). With valid 8-char format 'ZZZZZZZZ', button enables. Full join failure alert copy could not be captured because RN Alert.alert() renders as an in-app <Modal>/notification that our page.on('dialog') hook does not catch, but the underlying joinByCode returns error='Could not find the function join_group_by_code' → user would see 'Impossible de rejoindre : Could not find the function ...' (not the intended 'Code introuvable ou expiré'). Recommend mapping PGRST202 / PGRST205 error codes to a friendlier message in familyCloud.ts joinByCode.

11_persistence_reload.notes: AUDIT-GROUP-A persists across full page navigation / new browser context (Zustand AsyncStorage persist works).

12_cleanup.notes: AUDIT-GROUP-A is still present locally in the e2e-test@budgy.ch session. It has NOT been pushed to Supabase (group_invites/member_user_ids missing → publishInviteCode failed → no cross-account artefact). Nothing to clean server-side. Main agent may want to prompt user to delete AUDIT-GROUP-A from their local device before Build 70 shipping — or leave it as a harmless leftover.

critical.issue: PGRST205 — table does not exist. SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql migration NOT applied.
42703 — column does not exist. RLS extension for cross-user access impossible.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught 'Share is not supported in this browser' when Share.share() is invoked on web preview. Wrap the call in try/catch so it degrades to Clipboard.setStringAsync on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/more/family.tsx:280.

Raw Supabase error string ('Could not find the function ...') is surfaced verbatim in the Alert when the RPC is missing. Should be mapped to the same 'invite_not_found' branch to show the localised message.

integration_issues.issue: Silent warn-log-only failure means the user thinks they successfully generated a shareable code, but it is unusable on any other device/account. Suggest surfacing a non-blocking banner when publish fails with a schema error.

react_native_issues.issue: Share module has no web fallback; throws unhandled on Expo Web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app/more/family.tsx:280.
Pre-existing deprecation warnings (non-blocking, already noted in iteration_8).

action_items: USER (owner of Supabase project) MUST run /app/docs/SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql in the Supabase SQL editor on https://supabase.budgy.ch. Verify with: SELECT to_regclass('public.group_invites'); SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='expense_groups' AND column_name='member_user_ids'; SELECT proname FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('join_group_by_code','leave_group'). All must return non-null.

MAIN AGENT: wrap Share.share(...) in /app/frontend/app/more/family.tsx:280 with try { await Share.share(...) } catch(e) { if(Platform.OS==='web'){ await Clipboard.setStringAsync(shareBase+suffix); Alert.alert('Code copié','Le message a été copié dans le presse-papier.'); } }

MAIN AGENT: in /app/frontend/src/services/familyCloud.ts joinByCode(), map any error containing 'Could not find' / PGRST202 / PGRST205 to error='invite_not_found' so the UI shows 'Code introuvable ou expiré' instead of the raw SQL message.
AFTER migration applied → re-run this test suite (scenarios 2–9) to fully validate cross-device Family cloud.
critical_code_review_comments: publishInviteCode currently swallows schema errors as a console.warn only. Consider bubbling schema errors (PGRST20x) as a distinct 'schema_missing' status so the UI can show 'Fonctionnalité indisponible — mettez à jour l'app'.

The absence of a client-side pre-flight (e.g., a lightweight SELECT 1 FROM group_invites LIMIT 0) means the family feature silently degrades on prod when infra is missing. A one-shot health check at app boot would surface migration drift immediately.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql was NOT executed on the live Supabase project despite the request text claiming otherwise. Direct REST verification (see backend_issues.critical) confirms: (1) table public.group_invites → PGRST205, (2) column expense_groups.member_user_ids → 42703, (3) function public.join_group_by_code → PGRST202, (4) function public.leave_group → PGRST202. Reproduction: `curl https://supabase.budgy.ch/rest/v1/group_invites?select=code&limit=1 -H 'apikey: <anon>'` returns 404 PGRST205. Mitigation: open Supabase Studio → SQL Editor → paste /app/docs/SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql → Run. Additional secondary bug: React Native Share.share() has no web fallback and throws uncaught in web preview (family.tsx:280); this does NOT affect iOS/Android runtime but should be wrapped for a clean Expo Web dev experience.
